phrase.zh: 换一种射线，进入更小的尺度。
phrase.en: A different beam reveals a smaller scale.

visual.zh: 显微装置与细密样本纹理并置，用镜筒和微观图案表现放大观察。画中颗粒不是某份生物或材料样本的照片。
visual.en: A microscope-like instrument stands beside fine sample textures, suggesting magnified observation. The particles are not a photo of a biological or material specimen.

background.zh: 电子显微镜用电子束和电磁透镜形成图像，而不依赖可见光透镜。恩斯特·鲁斯卡因电子光学和首台电子显微镜的设计获得 1986 年物理学诺贝尔奖的一半。
background.en: Electron microscopes form images with electron beams and electromagnetic lenses instead of visible-light optics. Ernst Ruska received half of the 1986 Physics Nobel Prize for electron optics and designing the first electron microscope.
